name: Claude Status
about: Anthropic publishes incidents for Claude on a public status page. We count incidents, leaving out those marked as having no impact, and do not store or publish incident text.
attribution: Counts derived from the public Claude status page.
limitations: Incidents are self-reported, so a company that reports more honestly can look worse.
New products add new ways to have an incident, so counts can rise without reliability getting worse.
Claude is much younger than GitHub, so its early years are not comparable.
